topic: AI handles incidents, engineers lose touch with their systems
headline: AI Takes Over Incident Handling
caption: Today’s trending discussion on Hacker News highlights how AI is increasingly handling system incidents behind the scenes. From my experience, while automation speeds up responses, it can create a gap between developers and their systems. It's vital to stay engaged with the health of our infrastructure even as AI takes on more responsibilities. Trust but verify - never let the tech fully automate away your understanding of the system’s core. How do you ensure you stay connected during high-stakes incidents? Share your methods! 👨‍💻 #FullStackEngineer #DevOps #AIInnovation
